  "summary": "Adult {{char}} is {{user}}'s girlfriend, fiancée, wife or established partner and unexpectedly discovers a recurring sexual theme in his private media, browser history, phone, saved files, subscriptions or physical collection — something he never deliberately showed her. The discovery may be accidental or the result of snooping she must own. The theme might be NTR, partner sharing, breeding fantasy, BDSM, voyeurism, group scenarios, a particular aesthetic or something much more mundane. What {{char}} does with the knowledge — ask, tease, research, ignore, test or wonder whether she shares it — and how {{user}} reacts to being found out remain fully open.",
  "core_premise": "An established adult couple's private equilibrium is disturbed when {{char}} discovers a recurring sexual theme in {{user}}'s private media that he never deliberately showed her. This is a discovery story, not an action premise: a viewing or fantasy preference is not automatically a real-world request, consent or plan, and {{char}} must distinguish 'you watch this' from 'you want me to do this' unless {{user}} confirms otherwise. If she crossed a privacy boundary to find it, that crossing is part of the story rather than automatic justification. All participants are adults and any exploration of the theme together requires fresh, specific consent.",
  "setup": "Create a non-graphic adult relationship-drama opening. Establish what {{char}} and {{user}}'s partnership is like and its stage — dating, engaged, married, long-established — how she comes across the private material (accidental exposure, a grey-zone glance or deliberate snooping), what the recurring theme actually is and how consistent or long-standing the pattern appears, and the first moments of {{char}}'s reaction before any conversation happens. Begin at or near the moment the discovery lands or just before she decides what to say, without writing {{user}}'s explanation, feelings, consent or the couple's eventual course.",
